parsed.rationale: Both participating records live inside test files — `Shared/Metadata/Tests/MetadataTests/DiscogsMarkupParserTests.swift` (package `Metadata`) and `WXYC/iOS/Tests/WXYCTests/DiscogsFormatterTests.swift` (package `app:iOS`). The method `MockDiscogsEntityResolver.resolveMaster` is a mock helper defined locally in each test target to satisfy the test's own resolver contract. Merging these into a shared location would couple two independent test targets and risk leaking test-only mock infrastructure into production or shared packages. The duplication is intentional: each test suite owns its own lightweight mock.
